title: La baita
story: Cinque amici passano il weekend in una baita isolata dalla neve. La mattina dopo quattro si svegliano e trovano il quinto morto nel suo letto. La porta della sua stanza era chiusa a chiave da dentro e fuori, sulla neve, non c'è nessuna impronta.
solution: Il quinto amico dormiva da solo al piano terra, nella stanza con la stufa a legna; gli altri dormivano di sopra. Prima di andare a letto ha caricato la stufa al massimo e ha chiuso la porta a chiave, come faceva sempre. Durante la notte la neve ha ostruito il comignolo: il fumo non usciva più e la stanza si è riempita di monossido di carbonio, un gas senza odore. È morto nel sonno. Nessuno l'ha ucciso.
solution_facts: Five friends spent the weekend in a mountain cabin, cut off by the snow. Only the five of them were there.
The fifth friend slept alone in the ground-floor room, where there was a wood-burning stove. The other four slept upstairs.
Before going to bed he loaded the stove to the maximum and locked his door from inside, as he always did.
During the night the snow blocked the chimney of the stove.
The smoke could no longer get out, and his room filled with carbon monoxide, a gas with no smell.
He died in his sleep, poisoned by the gas, without waking up.
Nobody killed him: it was an accident.
The gas stayed in his locked room; the others slept far from it and survived.
In the morning the four friends found him dead. Nobody had entered or left the cabin, so there were no footprints in the snow.
NOT TRUE: one of the friends or someone from outside killed him; poison; a secret passage or the window; a heart attack or an illness; he froze to death.
